notes: BUU v3.1.4 - PestPac session/license fixes. The elastic license check had been silently failing since the login rebuild (a wiring bug), so the free-license BUFFER was never enforced and the pool could consume every seat until no one could log in. This release fixes that: the license cap works again, the buffer is an absolute floor (the pool hard-stops rather than taking the last seats), every logout is now VERIFIED (proven on the server, retried) so sessions stop leaking, the license checker shows as its own counted card, and setup/teardown default to running once per job. Also: restored the sidebar Stop button and fixed the in-app updater so it reliably launches the installer. NOTE: significant change to license scaling - watch the first PestPac run.
